caller_is_authorized.meaning: the caller of rebalanceFunds() is an authorized caller (report states no access control exists, so authorization is not enforced)

rebalance_invoked.meaning: rebalanceFunds() was invoked by a caller

event_spam_created.meaning: the permissionless rebalanceFunds() call emitted events and triggered custodian transfers, creating spam in event logs and monitoring systems

assumptions: rebalanceFunds() is callable by any address because it lacks an access control modifier, per p_no_access_control.
The spam impact concerns event-log and monitoring spam from permissionless calls, not fund movement amounts.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify whether rebalanceFunds() actually moves funds or only emits events in the spam scenario, so the custodian-transfer component of the spam impact is not separately bound.

limitations: Authorization is modeled as a grounded Boolean because the report states the absence of access control without naming an authorized caller set.
The spam impact is represented as a single observable Boolean; no numeric event-count or transfer-count bound is given in the report.
